units.claim: The database, redis, config and options folders hold the technical plumbing (DB provider, Redis client, env config) that services consume.
Feature services and the DTO/model files under models folders carry the application logic and data shapes.
Controllers, Nest modules and guards form the outer transport and wiring layer.
The preset order (infrastructure → application → presentation) holds: controllers call services, and services call the database, redis and config plumbing.
